YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Emergency door opening

Locked out? Get help with a closed door, lost keys or a failed lock. Call for 24/7 emergency door opening and a current arrival estimate.

Call 0203 7720564Send an enquiry

Getting you back inside

Tell us whether the door has simply closed behind you, the key is missing, or the lock will no longer turn. These situations can need different approaches. The locksmith assesses the lock before choosing an entry method.

Entry methods and damaged locks

Non-destructive techniques are considered first. A damaged mechanism or failed lock may require replacement; the locksmith explains the proposed work before starting. Wooden, uPVC, composite and aluminium doors can be assessed.

What to tell us when you call

Give your location, door type and whether a key is stuck or broken. Let us know if anyone is unable to leave the property. Call rather than send a website enquiry for urgent help.

Guide price

£89 guide price for emergency door opening. The locksmith assesses the job and confirms the price before work starts.
